context.passage:
Parking in this area is reserved for
vehicles displaying a current permit
sticker on their windshields. Stickers
may be obtained at the Willistown
municipal building. Unauthorized
vehicles may be towed away at
vehicle owners' expense.
Minimum fine $100.00
